categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in automotive electronic components manufacturing, focusing on advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) including ultrasonic radar systems, automotive cameras, millimeter-wave radar, and wireless RF technologies. Key product lines include parking sensors, rearview cameras, vehicle anti-theft devices, blind spot detection systems, and smart key systems. The company also engages in wholesale and retail of automotive parts and related machinery.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include ultrasonic radar, automotive imaging, 77 GHz millimeter-wave radar, and wireless RF communication (UWB/BT/NFC). Production emphasizes intelligent, modular, and systematized design with continuous process improvements and automation to enhance efficiency and quality. The company invests heavily in R&D for ASIC integration, AI-based intelligent driving assistance, and digital communication technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are global automotive OEMs including Japanese, Chinese, American, and European car manufacturers. The company serves mainly the original equipment manufacturing (OEM) market, supplying components for new vehicle assembly. Major markets include Taiwan, China, Southeast Asia, the United States, and Europe, with a focus on expanding in China and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover Taiwan, China, Thailand, Malaysia, Japan, Indonesia, India, the United States, Southeast Asia, and Europe. The company has manufacturing and sales subsidiaries in these regions, with Thailand serving as a Southeast Asian operational hub. The geographic strategy leverages regional advantages to respond flexibly to market and trade changes.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a Tier 1 automotive electronic components supplier within the automotive supply chain, providing advanced sensing and electronic modules directly to vehicle manufacturers. It is positioned midstream, focusing on design, manufacturing, and system integration of automotive electronic parts.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in sensing technologies, intelligent driving assistance, and digital communication for automotive applications. The company emphasizes product diversification, international marketing, and compliance with global automotive safety regulations. R&D focuses on AI-enabled ADAS, integration of radar and imaging sensors, and development of new wireless key technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of automotive electronic components to OEM customers. The company also derives income from related aftermarket products and services. Sales are recognized upon delivery to customers, with a focus on expanding order volumes and new product adoption.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a highly specialized automotive electronics market dominated by a few global players. It holds a stable position as a certified supplier to major global car manufacturers, leveraging long-term partnerships and technical certifications (e.g., TS-16949). Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, product quality, and cost competitiveness through global procurement and manufacturing efficiency.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, consolidated revenue reached approximately NT$5.24 billion, reflecting an 8.86% growth over the prior year. Net profit after tax was about NT$203 million. The company maintains a stable financial structure with increasing equity and decreasing liabilities. R&D investment accounts for around 8% of revenue, supporting sustained growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, reliable automotive sensing and electronic systems that enhance vehicle safety and driver convenience. Its products are differentiated by advanced sensing technologies, modular and intelligent system design, and compliance with stringent automotive standards. Long-term customer relationships and strong technical support further reinforce its value proposition.
